title: The Zero-Day Alibi

plots.logline: When an expert who creates alibis from ordinary digital traces is forced to conceal a murder for a mysterious client, she discovers that she is the mastermind who hired him—and that he knew from the beginning and took the bait to seize her black-data vault.
plots.surface_plot: Mara believes Adrian killed Claire Thorne and is using a Crisis Management contract to force Mara to create an alibi, with twenty-four hours before police discover Claire's death.
plots.true_plot: Mara Voss secretly hired Adrian Thorne to kill Claire Thorne and planned to frame Adrian while taking Claire's shares. Adrian knew Mara was the mastermind before entering the office and needs Mara to open the Zero-Day Server. Both believe they hold the final leverage.
plots.ending_book1: Claire's death remains an open homicide investigation because the ghost vehicle and altered smartwatch prevent a suicide ruling. No arrest is made yet; Mara and Adrian enter a conditional partnership while both remain exposed.
plots.hook_book2: Det. Miller escalates the unresolved homicide inquiry after finding a second inconsistency in Claire's smartwatch log, forcing Mara and Adrian to coordinate their next counter-move.
plots.author_directive: Tone: clinical, hyper-competent, cold to the point of pain. Every chapter is a counter-move.
plots.notes: Clinical, hyper-competent, cold to the point of pain. Dark romance is Mutual Assured Destruction. Trope: Zero-Trust Romance. Tropes: Mutual Digital Predation / Competence Porn.

villain_ledger.action: In the opening stretch Adrian knows Mara is the mastermind but does not know she shifted the time of death.

In the middle stretch Adrian knows Mara is building the ghost-vehicle frame and deliberately lets it run because he retains a signed forensic snapshot proving her workstation generated it; he withholds that countermeasure until it can force her to open the Zero-Day Server.
